# GRP-2109  allow templates to be generated by gsh

_(no description)_

## Comments

### mchyzer - 2019-04-23T19:00:38.726+0000

fixed in patch: grouper_v2_4_0_ui_patch_23

go to gsh from the UI (grouper/WEB-INF/bin/gsh), and run this:
{code:java}GrouperSession grouperSession = GrouperSession.startRootSession();
edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.beans.ui.StemTemplateContainer templateContainer = new edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.beans.ui.StemTemplateContainer();
templateContainer.setTemplateKey("myTestApp2");
templateContainer.setTemplateFriendlyName("My test app 2");
templateContainer.setTemplateDescription("This is my test app 2");
templateContainer.setCreateNoSubfolder(false);
Stem stem = StemFinder.findByName(grouperSession, "test2", true);
edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.beans.ui.GrouperTemplateLogicBase templateLogic = edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.serviceLogic.UiV2Template.getTemplateLogic("service", templateContainer);
templateLogic.setStemId(stem.getUuid());
edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.beans.ui.GrouperRequestContainer.assignUseStaticRequestContainer(true);
List allServiceActions = templateLogic.getServiceActions();
List selectedServiceActions = new ArrayList(allServiceActions);
boolean allGood = templateLogic.validate(selectedServiceActions);if (!allGood) {throw new RuntimeException("Not valid! " + templateContainer.getTemplateKey());}
for (edu.internet2.middleware.grouper.grouperUi.beans.ui.ServiceAction serviceAction: selectedServiceActions) { serviceAction.getServiceActionType().createTemplateItem(serviceAction); }
{code}
